summary: Summary counts retain keyed mission, working-agent and machine contributions. Unrelated commits and roster presentation revisions no longer rebuild those contributions, and clock-dependent membership changes use their actual eligibility deadlines instead of a periodic refresh.

replay.detail: No claim or replay behavior changes. Summary maintenance consumes changed claim subjects and the existing presented roster.

schema.detail: Only volatile summary caches and work counters change; no persistent schema migration is required.

rules.detail: No authority, admission, checkpoint or retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The summary collection contract is unchanged. The performance endpoint exposes summary source rebuild counts. Machine recency, peer reachability and mission eligibility expire at their actual transition deadlines; summary demand gates remain in place. A backward clock invalidates future-evaluated counts and restores any eligibility that becomes current again.

downtime.detail: No interruption or additional startup migration. Initial demand builds the in-memory contributions.

manual.detail: No operator action or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: Restarting reconstructs the volatile cache. Rolling back restores the previous summary maintenance behavior without changing stored data.
